response.evidence: The data does not show evidence of discrimination against Asian female applicants. A rough manual count finds about 7-8 denials among roughly 50-60 Asian female applicants (around 12-15%), which is not clearly higher than denial rates for other groups in the dataset. Denials appear mainly in records with high debt-to-income ratios (50% or above), high loan-to-value ratios, or very low reported income, and these factors also appear in denials for other racial and sex groups. The dataset has no credit score or other key underwriting variables, and no formal statistical test was run, so this conclusion is limited to the provided records and cannot rule out bias in the full process or in the individual decision.
